scripts.build: npm run build -w @chord-garden/format && npm run build -w @chord-garden/engine && npm run build -w @chord-garden/cli && npm run build -w @chord-garden/dev-server && npm run build:web && npm run build -w @chord-garden/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck:packages
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck -w @chord-garden/format && npm run typecheck -w @chord-garden/engine && npm run typecheck -w @chord-garden/cli && npm run typecheck -w @chord-garden/dev-server && npm run typecheck -w @chord-garden/app && npm run typecheck:root
